dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000sadt](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000sadt) Magnitude 5.8 earthquake at 90.712 depth occurred on Feb 20 2026 20km NE of Kharo. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 35.593 longitude 69.7614. It impacted 182392 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
